metadata.description: xOS Marketplace — Platform for xOS engines. First-party primitives ship here; third-party contributors (60% revenue share) publish engines in any category. Engines are independently versioned repos. Dependency declarations enforce minimum compatible versions. Installed via Claude Code plugin system.
metadata.branding_note: xOS brand term is 'engine' not 'plugin'. The plugin[] field and .claude-plugin/ convention are Claude Code technical infrastructure — not user-facing terminology.

plugins.name: career-intelligence
plugins.description: Career Intelligence Engine — xHumanOS engine for job search, network, pipeline, sessions. v0.73.4: XOS-98 LOCAL beta-funnel + NSM telemetry — shared src/telemetry/ primitive (onboarding/first-artifact/activation/d7 + VOW + active-time events), local-only JSONL, XOS_98_TELEMETRY-gated, ZERO network (honors the public no-phone-home promise; PostHog outbound transport stays human-gated). v0.73.3: warm-intro badge (XOS-85) + standalone cover-letter skill (XOS-103) + interview-prep auto-surface (XOS-105). v0.73.0: workspace-binding gate primitive replacing the 3 duplicated hook cwd-guards (the 408-stray-commits incident). Carries v0.72 dedup-gate JSON fix + v0.71 claim-grounding gate (resume-engine no longer fabricates metrics).

plugins.name: super-developer
plugins.description: Super Developer Engine - global agentic-SDLC ship-feature pipeline for every repo. v0.6.0: Stage 9 PUBLISH+BROADCAST+ENSURE (XOS-142) — post-merge, artifact-class-routed (plugin→marketplace+reload-bulletin; cyborg→route-sync-to-cyborg-agent; workspace→sync.sh; SaaS→cache-bust+client-reload+flag+migration+verify-live) + ship-feature-publish-gate skew detector (installed<marketplace → BLOCK + loud reinstall line). 'Shipped' = activated across the running swarm, not merged. v0.5.0: cross-family judge UNSKIPPABLE (XOS-138) — Stage 6 non-optional + FAIL-HARD, canonical `ship-feature-judge-receipt:v1` in every PR body, merge-gate BLOCKs receiptless `gh pr merge`. v0.4.1: Stage 5.5 (E2E+VISUAL) + 5.6 (/simplify) + 5.7 (rerun). v0.3.0: SELF-CONTAINED SDLC rules via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. User-scope, workspace_binding=global. Canonical source: Exponential-OS/xos monorepo plugins/cross/super-developer (derived vendored mirror, overwritten on each sync).

plugins.name: co-dialectic
plugins.description: Co-Dialectic v4.27.0 - XOS-146 in-message status-header no-fabricate / no-silent-drop. New Stop hook status-liveness-check verifies the model-authored Protocol 1 header against ~/.codialectic/state.json using the SAME freshness rule as statusline.sh (one shared rule, so the in-message header and terminal status line can never disagree): a score may appear only when codi is LIVE; otherwise the header is forced to '⚠ Codi DEGRADED' with no numbers. Catches fabrication / inconsistent / silent-drop / missing-degraded-header; response-unreadable fails open silently while missing/corrupt state is treated as DEGRADED and still evaluated. Builds on v4.26.0 (XOS-141) structural terminal-statusLine liveness.

plugins.name: brand-intelligence
plugins.description: Brand Intelligence — Persona schema, extraction, and registry. N-voice support for individuals (xHumanOS, N=1) and orgs (xTeamOS, N≥3). Includes persona-onboarding interview, handles, channel directory. Foundational primitive — no dependencies.

plugins.name: knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Knowledge Graph — Graph data layer for all xOS engines. Phase 1: JSON files. Phase 2: Neo4j substrate replacing all engine file stores. Foundational primitive — no dependencies.

plugins.name: brand-amplification
plugins.description: Brand Amplification Engine (BAE) — outbound brand-building umbrella. v0.55.0: post-algorithm content-strategy reset (relevance > volume) — content-flywheel Reset section (topic-audience fit, audience specificity, engagement-quality-over-velocity) + campaign-engine Relevance Gate (relevance_score ≥ 70 to proceed, else gap + sharpening) + local-only XOS_98_TELEMETRY-gated content_strategy_applied event (no phone-home). Includes the social distribution engine (SDE master orchestrator), flywheel amplification module, hub-and-spoke surface coverage, 9-gate preflight CI for content campaigns, golden-hour scheduling, invisible signal CTAs (bookmark/save/DM-share), platform-native routing across LinkedIn / Substack / Reddit / X / Instagram / Facebook / Threads, and the confidence-ladder browser MCP defaults (browserbase for setup; chrome-devtools-mcp for posting per Irreversible-Action Invariant).

plugins.name: coordination
plugins.description: xOS Coordination engine — brain-multi-session-sync skill. Git-backed session state sync across local Claude, cloud Claude, Cursor, Codex. Session-start hook pulls workspace state and surfaces it as Tier 1.5 context in co-dialectic waky-waky. Install once via setup.sh; workspace declares status format via AGENT_STATUS.yaml convention. v0.3.0: Linear work-bus pull resolves team/project from the workspace WIP→goal map and scopes queries by project when configured.

plugins.name: content-adapt
plugins.description: Content Adapt — Transform engine. One idea → platform-native variants (xHumanOS) or audience-specific variants (xTeamOS). Reads Brand Intelligence personas; queries Knowledge Graph for source context.

plugins.name: xos
